title: Gastric Cancer Tumor Microenvironment Characterization Reveals Stromal-Related Gene Signatures Associated With Macrophage Infiltration.
summary: Gastric-cancer tumor microenvironment analysis identifies stromal/immune signatures associated with macrophage infiltration and prognosis. The specific finding comes from tumor cohort molecular profiling, with observational rather than causal interpretation.
